name: Spinner
description: Circular indeterminate loading indicator, sized in pixels, with a dark-surface variant.
notes: border-top-color (the spinning 'head') is --color-brand-primary (or #fff literal when onDark — no on-dark accent token exists, kept as source's literal white). border thickness defaults to 2.5px, off the --border-width-* scale, kept as a raw number. Rotation is a continuous CSS animation, not a static field.
